research.facts:
Câmara's Dilemma
**Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Rafael Câmara: Brazilian rookie, Haas F1 driver for final 2026 rounds
- F2 championship lead: 7 points over Nikita Tsolov (Red Bull reserve)
- Qatar F1 round AND Qatar F2 round are on the same weekend
- Same situation for Abu Dhabi finale
- It is "effectively impossible" to race in both F1 and F2 on same weekend
- Brazil debut (Interlagos): finished P20 (last), 2 laps down
- Las Vegas: second F1 outing
- Haas originally committed him only for Interlagos; kept him for Las Vegas
- 2027 Haas driver confirmed
- Regional conflict concern: Iran-US conflict adds uncertainty to Qatar/Abu Dhabi rounds
